value.rationale: Anonymizing individual knowledge invites the concrete inverse question whether full access to all bundled formula evaluations recovers three S5 agent partitions. This first-sharp six-world classification shows connected joint accessibility does not suffice: two non-permutation-equivalent reconstructions survive. The exact ten exceptional labelled signatures and Latin-square structure identify a natural combinatorial obstruction, rather than an arbitrary narrow count; comparison to two-agent uniqueness isolates a substantive change at three agents.
